newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BoE panel to discuss pound/demand tension - George.
newsitem.headline: BoE panel to discuss pound/demand tension - George.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said the bank's new monetary policy committee would examine the "degree of tension" between the strength of the pound and high U.K. domestic demand when it holds its inaugural meeting this week.

"The immediate problem is to balance the degree of tension between the pressure of domestic demand which has been running a bit above a sustainable rate with the exaggerated strength of the exchange rate," George told reporters at the International Monetary Conference in Interlaken.

He said this matter would be discussed at the first meeting of the monetary policy committee, which was set up after the new Labour government announced on May 6 that it was handing the central bank independence in setting interest rates.
